description: Two ADSR envelopes sharing one set of stage knobs, each able to loop and each with a VCA on its output.

params.text: Decay time, shared by both envelopes.
Attack time, shared by both envelopes.
Sustain level, shared by both envelopes.
Release time, shared by both envelopes.
How much the TIME 1 jack stretches or shortens the first envelope's stages.
How much the TIME 2 jack stretches or shortens the second envelope's stages.
Sets what happens after a stage finishes: up, each envelope runs once per gate; middle, the attack and decay repeat; down, the envelope restarts once it has settled on the sustain level.

inputs.text: Stretches or shortens the second envelope's stages, by as much as the MOD 2 knob allows.
Stretches or shortens the first envelope's stages, by as much as the MOD 1 knob allows.
A gate for the first envelope: it attacks on the rise and releases on the fall.
A gate for the second envelope: it attacks on the rise and releases on the fall.
Audio for the first VCA. Patch something here and OUT 1 carries that audio shaped by the first envelope rather than the envelope voltage.
Audio for the second VCA. Patch something here and OUT 2 carries that audio shaped by the second envelope rather than the envelope voltage.

outputs.text: The second envelope as a voltage, or the audio at IN 2 with that envelope applied when IN 2 is patched.
The first envelope as a voltage, or the audio at IN 1 with that envelope applied when IN 1 is patched.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
With both TIME jacks empty the two envelopes differ: TIME 1 reads as its lowest value and TIME 2 as its highest, so the second envelope runs slower than the first.

inputs.0:
±5.3V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the longest stage times.
inputs.1:
±5.3V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the shortest stage times.
inputs.2:
high above 1.32V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.3:
high above 1.32V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
